title: Planner: Planner Plugin lets Copilot Cowork read and update plans and tasks
summary: The Planner capabilities, rollout, administrator enablement and licensing are supported. Hold the briefing because its spending-policy route omits the required Identity scope choice; the route must distinguish a user-based policy from a resource-based policy. All cited Microsoft pages opened successfully, including the updated plugin-management page.
